description: Read a person's own agenda on OpenVibe.Today, for that person (plan L48 V3, "plan my day"): a first-party service such as OpenVibe.Chat's Vibe names the person with X-OV-Subject and gets the same agenda the person sees at openvibe.today/me (their reminders at their times, their events and saved events, imported calendars, and the streams of people they follow when Today knows them). Read-only: nothing is set, changed or kept by reading it.
